items.title: A non-first principal minor has finite weighted expectation zero

source.anchor: AppendixB2.1 LemmaB6 Eq15; row-reflection displays A2.Ex53-54 and final principal-minor expansion/evaluation; standing assumptions AppendixB2
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. ASTIS mathematical restatement with source coordinate1 represented by Fin n coordinate0.

items.statement: Let n>=3 and let O be drawn from the actual normalized Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group O(n). Put U=O_11. Let h:R->R be Borel with E|h(U)| finite. If a principal index set S contains an index i other than the first coordinate, then det(O_(S,S))h(U) is integrable and its expectation is zero. The empty principal determinant equals one.
assumptions: n>=3; S is a finite principal index set and i belongs to S but is not the first coordinate.
The probability law is the existing concrete full orthogonal Haar law, with inherited finite real matrix topology and its Borel sigma-algebra. No restriction to SO(n) or determinant-conditioned law.
h:R->R is Borel measurable, and its actual composition with U=O_11 is integrable under that Haar probability. h itself need not be bounded.

obligations.label: A non-first principal minor has finite weighted expectation zero

bindings.boundary: Only the actual LemmaB6 signed normalization integral identity and finite weighted principal-minor cancellation. Gaussian laws/densities, Fubini, spherical Poisson identities, radial/Hellinger separation, determinant-conditioned posteriors and transcript equality, eigenbasis/Krylov reductions and both main lower bounds remain separate open obligations. The source sharp principal-minor bound1 and path norm lower bound2 are not separately claimed as compiled estimates: sufficient alternate finiteness/kernel routes are explicitly disclosed.

assumption_deltas.source: Borel h, E|h(U)| finite, actual full orthogonal Haar law; n>=3 and kappa>=4 where the precision normalizer is used. A selected reflected row belongs to S and differs from the first coordinate.
assumption_deltas.lean: The same actual law and Borel/L1 source binders. Weighted minor integrability and its finite bounds are outputs/internal dependencies; no h boundedness, SO restriction or assumed cancellation is introduced.
assumption_deltas.reason: The source sharp1 minor bound is replaced only for the finiteness subproof by continuous compact boundedness with a finite C. This is an explicit sufficient proof-route difference, not a source repair or changed theorem. All final constants, quantifiers and parity are exact.

items.statement: Let n>=3, kappa>=4, and let O have the actual full orthogonal Haar probability law. Write U=O_11 and A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T). For every Borel h with E|h(U)| finite, E[det(O)sqrt(det A_O)h(U)] equals ((-1)^(n-1)(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^n) E[((sqrt(kappa)+1)U-(sqrt(kappa)-1))h(U)].
assumptions: n>=3 and real kappa>=4, retaining AppendixB2 standing assumptions.
The same actual full orthogonal Haar probability and the same literal equation4 precision A_O are used. Square roots are nonnegative real square roots.
h:R->R is Borel measurable with actual E|h(O_11)| finite. Weighted-minor integrability, cancellation, determinant expansion and all linearity conditions are derived internally.
